tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang bskur bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang bskur bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang bskur bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi bsdus don phreng ba skor gsum gyi cha lag rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang bskur bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'phags pa rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas yid dang mthun par stegs bu'i steng du 'bru'i chos 'byung gi dbus su tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i steng mañji'i khar/ thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du chang la a mṛ ta'i ma ṇi ril bu btab pa'i kha dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng du me long bzhag pa'i khar bum par chu chang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga btab pa'i mgul chings dmar po dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan gyi khrod du seng ldeng phur bu dar dmar gyi cod pan bcings pa gzug /dpal gtor dmar po rgyan dang ldan pa rta mgos mtshan pa'i rtser bris skus brgyan pa dang*/ nang mchod kyang bshams pa'i mdun du mchod pa bsham/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su las bum thod rnga rdor dril 'du byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa/ bka' bsgo/ mchod pa dang nang mchod gzhan ltar byin gyis brlabs/ srung ba'i gur khang rdo rje me dang bcas pa'i dbus su| rang tha mal pa'i snying khar raṃ yig ser po'i 'od zer las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dmar po 'bar ba las bskal me lta bu 'od zer gyis rang lus khyab pas rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas kyi lus sbyangs/ 'od phung dmar por gyur pa'i dbus su rang sems hrīḥyig dmar po nyi ma ltar 'bar ba de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje be con nam mkhar phyar zhing*| g.yon rdo rje tho ba gdengs pa/ gdan pad+ma nyi zla bgegs kyi steng du zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bzhengs pa/ zhal rngam zhing khro gnyer g.yo ba/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar g.yo zhing gzigs pa/

shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub pa/ snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa/ ljags nas bskal pa'i glog 'khyug pa/ zhal nas hrīḥdang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sbrul rigs bzhis sku dang yan lag brgyan pa dbu'i gtsug na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher bas snang srid kyi lha dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bsgyings pa/ de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi lha// thugs rje rmad byung dbang chen 'bar ba'i sku// dbang gi mdog dmar bskal pa'i me ltar 'khrugs| |khro rngam rab 'jigs ye shes me dpung klong*// phyag g.yas rdo rje be con dgra bgegs 'joms// g.yon pa rdo rje tho bas srid gsum 'jig /mgo phreng sbrul dang stag lpags sku la gsol// gtum khro 'jigs pas khams gsum dbang du bsdus// rta skad rngam sgras stong gsum zil gyis gnon// byams brtse zhi bas srid gsum rjes su 'dzin// pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng*// dbang chen brkyang bskum gar gyis 'gying la bstod// ces bstod/

thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su hrīḥdamar po me 'od 'khrugs pa'i mthar| bzla bya'i sngags byu ru'i phreng ba lta bu g.yas su 'gal me ltar drag la myur bar 'khor bar gyur pa la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad/ oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa rtags nyams dang bstun zhing bzlas so// de nas bum mdun gtor ma sogs lhan cig bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi chos 'byung drag po chos dbyings dmar nag gru gsum me ri 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ thod pa dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ bum pa bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ gtor ma smad 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ chos 'byung dbus kyi tshe bum dang*/ bum thod kyi bcud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus dang*/ gtor ma'i snod rnams hrīḥyig dmar po nyi ma ltar 'bar ba de nyid yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis dpa' po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhes pa nas/ rigs lngas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'khor bar gyur gyi bar bdag skyed ltar las/ sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa rnams las glog gi zhags pa lta bu'i 'od zer dmar zhing g.yo la myur mgyogs thams cad du spros/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs mkhyen brtse nus mthu bsdus| rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog /sgrib pa sbyangs nas dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ bgegs dang log 'dren dgra bgegs dam sri ru tra thams cad la phog pas tshar bcad/ de rnams kyi tshe bsod dang dpal 'byor mthu stobs thams cad bsdus/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la sib sib thim par gyur par yang yang gsal btab la/

mdun bskyed bum thod gtor ma rnams la spyi mthun du gong gi sngags ci 'grub bzla/ thun mthar gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag mdun bum thod gtor ma'i lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i be con gyi rnam pa can/ 'od zer dmar po'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam bdun gyis dbul/ dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi lha// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /ces bar brjod/ sngar ltar mchod cing*/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun dngos dbang gi lha// sku mdog dmar po me ltar 'bar// rta skad drag pos gdug pa 'dul| |dbang mchog khro rgyal khyod phyag 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bum thod kyi lha rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mer gyis zhu nas bum thod kyi bcud dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur par bsam/ las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ci 'grub bzla'o// de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar maṇ+ḍal nas gtang rag gi bar dkyus ltar bdag 'jug blang ngo*// slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ nang mi gshin pa med pa'i slob ma rnams khrus bya/ mdun du bkod/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin la bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgoms/ slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams kyi snying khar raṃ yig ser po las skyes zhes pa nas/ bsgyings pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la rang nyid ces pa dor/ de lta bu'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi rnam par steng nas byon pa thams cad kha ba bab pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa thams cad sa'i ljang pa rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa thams cad sa'i rlangs pa 'khrigs pa lta bur gnam sa bar snang thams cad rta mgrin gyi skus khrigs mer gyis gang ba thams cad sku gar stabs dang rta bro chem chem/ gsung ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra skad 'brug stong ldir ba ltar 'ur 'ur/ thugs zab gsal bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes chen po'i ngang du cham cham byon nas slob ma rnams kyi lus la rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa'am/ rgya mtsho chen po la char pa bab pa ltar sib sib thim par bsam zhing*/ bzla bya'i sngags mthar ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra tsa la ya pheṃ pheṃ dza dzaḥhriṃ hrīṃ/ zhes rol mo'i sgra drag po dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i gu gul gyi dud pa dang bcas byin gyis brlabs/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya'o// dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/ slob mas/ dpa' bo khyod zhabs spangs nas ni// 'dren pa gzhan du ma mchis pas// rdo rje slob dpon gtso chen gyis// blo mchog ting 'dzin dbang bskur stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'i tshe mdun bskyed kyi lhas dbang gi dgongs pa yang dag par mdzad de dbang rnams kyi bskur tshig dang dag pa'i tshig don rnams ji lta bar slob ma'i rgyud la thob pa dpon slob gnyis kas bsam par bya'o// bum pa thogs te/ hrīḥ bum pa zlum po chos dbyings spros dang bral// nang bcud snying po longs sku rta mchog dpal// gang 'dul der snang sprul sku bum pa'i dbang*// bskur bas bde ba chen po'i gnas thob shog /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā rā dza ha ya grī ba kā ya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/

zhes bum pa mgor bzhag /bum chu khar sbyin/ de ltar bum pa sku'i dbang bskur bas gti mug gi dri ma dag /sku'i dbang thob| chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor smin/ sku rdo rje'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa grub par byas so/ /zhes dag pa brjod/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje me phyed sku dang ldan| |deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i sku ru mdzad du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog 'thor/ thod pa thogs te/ hrīḥ thod pa dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ */ nang gi bdud rtsi dpal chen dbang gi dngos// dgra bgegs kun 'joms dngos grub rdzas kyi mchog /gsung gi dbang bskur bde stong ye shes stsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā rā dza ha ya grī ba wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ thod pa mgrin par gtad/ bdud rtsi sbyin/ de ltar thod pa bdud rtsi gsung gi dbang bskur/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /gsung gi dbang thob/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor smin/ gsung rdo rje tshangs dbyangs 'gag pa med pa grub par byas so// dpal ldan rdo rje'i gsung 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i gsung du mdzad du gsol// zhes so// me long thogs te/ hrīḥ me long dpal dang stong pa'i rang bzhin la// sna tshogs 'char zhing rang grol rtog pa bral// spros med bden don ye shes rdo rje dngos// rnam kun mchog ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā rā dza ha ya grī ba tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ me long mig la bstan cing snying gar gtad/ de ltar gsal dwangs me long gi dbang bskur bas zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /thugs kyi dbang thob/ me long ye shes kyi ngo bor smin/ thugs rdo rje bde stong zag med zab gsal gnyis med grub par byas so// dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i thugs su mdzad du gsol/ */

zhes so// gtor ma thogs te/ hrīḥ gtor snod bhan+dha drag po chos kyi dbyings// dam rdzas rmad byung gtor ma 'dod yon bcas// dbang chen sku dang gnyis med yon tan dbang*// gang 'dod dgos 'byung dngos grub stsol gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā rā dza ha ya grī ba gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca swā/ zhes gtor ma lte bar gtad cing kham re zar bcug /nang mchod byin/ de ltar yon tan mi zad dam rdzas rmad byung gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag /yon tan gyi dbang thob/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor smin/ yon tan rdo rje ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes grub par byas so// dpal ldan rdo rje yon tan 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed yon tan ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i yon tan kun 'grub shog /ces so// phur bu thogs la/ hrīḥ rdo rje phur bu drag sngags gdug pa'i mtshon// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung mchog rta mgrin dbang*// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med rtsal ldan pa'i// rab 'byams las la dbang bsgyur dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā rā dza ha ya grī ba karma a bhi ṣiñca hā/ zhes phur bu gsang gnas dang lag par gtad/ de ltar rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbang bskur bas phrag dog gi dri ma dag /phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor smin/ zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa'i phrin las thams cad gegs med du 'grub par byas so// dpal ldan rdo rje phrin las 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed phrin las ldan// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i phrin las kun 'grub shog /ces shis pa brjod/ de nas sngags dbang gi don du/ slob mas/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ */

gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed lha'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas thon gcig tu 'dres te slob ma'i khar zhugs snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par bsam la/ bzla bya'i sngags tshar gsum rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// ces dang*/ a dī ka dī dang rten 'brel snying po brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de ni gsung gi snying po sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ lha'i thugs rgyud bskul ba la sogs pa don phun sum tshogs pa du ma'i bdag nyid du dbang bskur ba yin no/ /zhes dag pa brjod/ hrīḥ dbang chen kun 'dus dbang mchog mtshan dper ldan| |mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung mchog rta mgrin rgyal// yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs gsang dbang gi lha// mtha' bral dri med thugs kyi bkra shis shog /dbang chen nyi ma dbang mchog 'dus pa'i gtso/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod/ slob mas dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed bum thod gtor ma'i lha rnams la sngar ltar mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskangs/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed dang bum thod gtor ma'i lha ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs brjod/ dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab/ shis brjod/ bsngo ba/ smon lam bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud la bka' 'bum nyid du dbang bskur gsal bar ma gsungs kyang*/

mi rung ba ma yin par mthong nas rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi bsdus don phreng ba skor gsum gyi cha lag tu/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ shing lug gro bzhin can gyi dmar po'i stong pa dang po dus dge ba'i char pho brang rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba dag go// //maṅga laṃ//
